items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: The name 'Dukas' is mentioned by the Interviewer in a biblical context ('Peter called Dukas up'), but the Interviewee (George Mitchell) does not mention Dukas, nor does he respond to the name with any personal connection or knowledge of a specific individual named Dukas.

ctx.x: Peter called Dukas up. She had been dead. All glory. All glory. If we get in his limelight. If we get where he can use him. If we humble ourselves. If we listen to his words. All glory. Some of Jesus' words seem to be unreasonable. Thank God. What the preacher told me this morning from Arkansas. Just believe it. Just believe it. Eat the whole thing. Serve your shepherd. Eat my flesh. And drink my blood. You got no life in you. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. And from that time. Somebody left him. His disciples. Those…
